name: Dong Ni Ya de Chun Tian
source:
This game is about a girl in Russia in 1898-ish. She faces marriage and underlying social change in her life. Your choices can decide her life.

[From [url=https://cassandracrowley.itch.io/springofrussia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作讲述一位生活在约1898年俄国的女孩的故事。她的人生面临着婚姻的抉择，以及暗流涌动的社会变革。你的选择将决定她的一生。

[摘自[url=https://cassandracrowley.itch.io/springofrussia]itch.io[/url]]
